sinopsis.es: Cuatro niños se escabullen de sus camas y descubren que las estrellas empiezan a caer del cielo.
sinopsis.en: On a cool summer night, animals with eyes full of light leave the forest to venture into the alleys of a suburban neighborhood. Four children sneak out of their beds, and stars begin to fall from the sky. By the morning everything will have changed, but for now let’s run!
